description: In the dark archives of St Andrews University library, an ancient 16th-century leather tome records the terrifying winter of 1577 in Ettrick town.

When children began vanishing from the cobblestone streets, terrified villagers blamed Herbert Solomon—a solitary, emaciated recluse living deep within the pine woods with a wasting sickness. Blinded by panic and grief, a mob marched into the forest and burned his cabin to the ground.

Yet the disappearances did not stop. In the foggy alleys and cellars, his tall, gaunt shadow walked the streets. But when they finally cornered him, the truth buried in the cellar revealed who the real monster was.
A Scroll Kaos paper-cutout horror animation. Watch until the very end.
